title: Rapid UI Update Causing Uncontrolled Result Flooding on Interaction
body:
**Bug Description**
Whenever the red x or green check emojis are in the terminal, it causes the CLI to update rapidly and have a string of results that fill up the entire workspace

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: cursor
- Version: 1.0.53
- Feedback ID: 7e26d2ef-2eb2-4fba-830e-1ad5c922e667

**Errors**
